features:
QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Chewy, gluten free bars made without artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

PROTEIN BARS: These tasty snack bars are a good source of protein with 10g per serving

DELICIOUS TASTE: Made with roasted peanuts, semisweet chocolate chips, peanut butter, and more; The perfect snacks for kids and adults alike

FOR EVERY ADVENTURE: Sink your teeth into chewy snack bars that can be added to backpacks and lunch boxes; Stock them in the pantry for a delicious snack

CONTAINS: One regular cardboard box of Nature Valley Protein Chewy Bars, Peanut Butter Dark Chocolate, 5 bars, 7.1 oz; Perfect for instant snacking
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Semisweet Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Vegetable Oils (palm, palm kernel, canola, peanut), Sugar, Whey Protein Concentrate, Corn Syrup, Fructose, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Vegetable Glycerin, Rice Starch, Cocoa, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Corn Starch, Natural Flavor.
